summary_1line: Monkey search parties return to Sugriva after a month failing to find Sita, expressing hope that Hanuman alone may succeed.

image_candidates.scene_text: Exhausted monkey warriors bow before Sugriva and Rama on the ridge of Prasravana Mountain after a month-long fruitless search.
Bands of monkeys traverse wild forests, rivers, and mountains, scanning the wilderness for any sign of Sita.
Sushena stands before Sugriva and Rama, reporting the failure of the search while the gathered monkeys watch anxiously.
